On passing i to i+1 at most one new index crosses threshold since harmonic adjacent gaps ≥1/i exceed δ=1/(i+1); setting ε=2−(H_i−H_k) gives i(P_{i+1}−P_i)−P_i=k(ε−δ)+i(δ−ε)_+≥0 casewise.
